outcome: Characteristics of fetal neck mass (size, location, nature)
Histopathological examination results (benign mesenchymal spindle-cell tumor)
Correlation between prenatal imaging and postnatal findings
cohort: A 30-year-old pregnant woman (gravida 2, para 1) whose fetus was diagnosed with a right lateral neck mass.
finding: Prenatal fetal MRI, performed for investigation of fetal neck masses detected on ultrasound, provides compatible results observed in the neonate after birth and maintains adequate findings for follow-up and planning of treatment.
